thread:
Marco Ruiz: Hi all — quick calendar weirdness. Invite shows the orientation at 6:00 PM local for me (Madrid) but the welcome email said 9am PT. Also no meeting link in the event. Is that expected?
Aisha - People Ops: Welcome Marco! Canonical time is 9:00 AM PT. GCal should convert to your local TZ (18:00 CEST). Which email did you accept with? Sometimes personal emails cause the conferencing link to be hidden.
Marco Ruiz: I used marco.ruiz.work@gmail.com (I haven't set up my company address yet).
Priya - Onboarding: That explains it — if the event was created by onboarding@redwood.com Meet will attach only for guests inside our org by default. I just re-shared the invite explicitly to marco.ruiz.work@gmail.com and added a Zoom backup link in the description: https://zoom.redwood.example/j/222333444. Give it a few minutes to sync.
IT Support: Also check your calendar client: Outlook for desktop sometimes shows "See event details" without the link. Open the event in the web view and confirm the description. If missing, reply here and we'll resend a direct calendar link.
Marco Ruiz: Got the updated invite, can see the Zoom link now. Thanks! One more thing: will the session be recorded and where will we find the recording?
calendar-bot: Event updated: "New Hire Orientation - Redwood" — Recording enabled. Recording will be uploaded to the onboarding Drive folder and pinned in #new-hires within 24 hours. Slides will be attached 30 minutes prior.
Aisha - People Ops: Yep — slides go up ~30m before start. We also post a ~10 minute highlight clip for folks in Asia/APAC who can't attend live. If you need the full raw recording sooner, DM me and we can share it.
Anna (EM): Heads up for folks in very early or late TZs: we pin a short "how to join" note in the event with both Meet and Zoom options and an explicit timezone table (PT / UTC / CEST / IST / JST). Priya, can you add that to the description?
Priya - Onboarding: Done — added the TZ table + a 1-line join instruction and breakout room assignments. Also included a short troubleshooting FAQ: troubleshooting steps for missing link, duplicate ICS, and Outlook clients.
Marco Ruiz: Perfect — everything looks good now. Appreciate the fast help.
Aisha - People Ops: Welcome again Marco! If anyone else sees odd times (double events, DST quirks), drop your city + the email you accepted with and we'll reissue the invite.
